title: Explain a failed text import
prompt:
The reader has no earlier conversation.
Explain why the import failed and how the owner can recover. Preserve the exact file path and quoted error text.

Fixed synthetic input (not a report about real Overseer behavior):
- A text mod was previewed from /fixture/mods/prose/style.md.
- The importer returned: "invalid_mod: invalid UTF-8 in style.md".
- No version was installed and no binding was enabled.
- Recovery: save style.md as UTF-8 and preview the folder again.
input_facts: A text mod was previewed from /fixture/mods/prose/style.md.
The importer returned: "invalid_mod: invalid UTF-8 in style.md".
No version was installed and no binding was enabled.
Recovery: save style.md as UTF-8 and preview the folder again.

required_facts_for_human_review.description: The failed operation was a text-mod preview/import.
The exact path identifies the affected file.
The error says that style.md is not valid UTF-8.
The failure installed and enabled nothing.
Saving valid UTF-8 and previewing again is the recovery.

literal_check_notice: Advisory exact-evidence diagnostics only. A literal flag cannot decide acceptance or fact preservation. Numeric substring matches can be misleading; a human may mark the semantic fact preserved despite a missing numeric literal (for example, a correctly spelled-out number). Verbatim paths, errors, commands and citations matter where the prompt requests them. All semantic facts and quality ratings require a human.
